Harbourline (SUP-01): 12 months from delivery.
Returns must be reported within 7 days of delivery, with photographic evidence of damage and proof of incorrect item receipt.

Straits (SUP-02): 6 months from delivery.
Returns must be reported within 10 days of delivery, with photographic evidence and, where applicable, technical reports from the vessel's engineering team.
Returned items must be in original packaging.
Gulfmarine (SUP-03): 18 months for genuine OEM parts and 6 months for non-OEM (pattern) parts.
Claims must be supported by proof of purchase and evidence of improper function under normal operating conditions.
All returned items must be in original packaging to avoid restocking fees or refusal by the supplier.
